title: console login: under SSO enforcement the only working "Sign in with SSO" button sits behind the "Use a password instead" link
body:
domain:ui#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jQjvWkZ7is6GXbC6DB

Filing gate: ① a user-visible sign-in defect with a named location and a reproduction. It is an out-of-scope finding, class a, from #29159 (PR #29257) and was filed by `domain:ui#5`. ⛔ Not a claim. Not graded: triage sets the grade.

**Business reason.** On a deployment that enforces SSO (`OS_SSO_ENABLED=true OS_AUTH_SSO_ONLY=true`, with an OIDC provider registered), the sign-in card first shows only the SSO-only sentence and a link labelled "Use a password instead". The deployment's only working way in, the email-routed **Sign in with SSO** button, appears only after the user clicks that password link. A user told "sign in with your organization's single sign-on" sees no SSO control and is steered toward a password they may not have (JIT-provisioned SSO users have none). The operator docs (`content/docs/reference/security-and-compliance.mdx`) tell operators "When SSO is on you can disable password login entirely", so this is the configuration they are told to use.

**Reach: MEASURED at a public door** by the #29159 os-dev at `origin/main` `f6a04e3a`. The pre-fix `LoginForm` behaves the same on this path, and PR #29257 does not change it.
- Staging: a fresh showcase with `OS_SSO_ENABLED=true OS_AUTH_SSO_ONLY=true`. The admin (break-glass) called `POST /api/v1/auth/sso/register` for OIDC provider `acme-sso`, domain `acme.example`, and got 200.
- `GET /api/v1/auth/config` answered `emailPassword {enabled:true, disableSignUp:true}`, `features.sso: true`, `features.ssoEnforced: true`, `socialProviders: []`.
- Console `/login`, fresh Playwright context, 1280×800. First paint: the SSO-only copy, 0 "Sign in with SSO" buttons, 0 email fields, 0 password fields, and 1 "Use a password instead" link (the only control). After clicking that link: 1 SSO button, 1 email field, 1 password field. Typing `jane@acme.example` and clicking Sign in with SSO sends `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in/sso`, which returns 200 with the IdP authorize URL, and the browser navigates to the IdP.
- Screenshots: `/mnt/project-files/issue-29159/reach-sso-enforced-first-paint.png`, `/mnt/project-files/issue-29159/reach-sso-enforced-after-break-glass.png`.
- Named producer: none in examples, scripts or hotcrm (`git grep ssoOnlyMode|OS_AUTH_SSO_ONLY|OS_SSO_ENABLED`). The producers are deployments that follow the operator docs.

**Where (on `main` after PR #29257).** `ui/packages/auth/src/LoginForm.tsx`: the email-routed SSO button renders inside the password form block, which is collapsed under enforcement (`passwordFormCollapsed`) until the break-glass link sets `showPasswordFallback`. The SSO-only view draws only `SocialSignInButtons` (federated providers) and the break-glass link.

**Wanted.**
1. Under declared enforcement with `features.sso: true`, the first paint offers the SSO path itself: the email field that routes to the IdP plus the "Sign in with SSO" button, with no password field.
2. "Use a password instead" stays the break-glass route to the password form and keeps its meaning.
3. A deployment with federated providers only, a non-enforced deployment, and the no-method state from #29159 are unchanged.

**Tests.** `{ssoEnforced:true, sso:true}` shows an email field and the SSO button at first paint and no password field. The break-glass link still reveals the password field. Ablation: restoring the button inside the collapsed form makes the case red.

**Reader.** `domain:ui` (`ui/packages/auth`), size S. Serialize after PR #29257 (#29159) and seat 2's #29105 (`LoginPage.tsx`).

**Dedupe.** Searched `"Sign in with SSO" enforced login` (6 hits) and `ssoEnforced break-glass SSO button` (2 hits: #29159, the parent of this finding; #25083, closed, hosted SSO-only user management, a different door). No card covers this.

Links back: #29159, PR #29257.
